subject: Vendor onboarding: MSA redline + PO field mapping (VertaCloud)
messages:
From: Helen Park <hpark@vertacloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@vertacloud.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: MSA redline + PO field mapping (VertaCloud)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick intake call earlier. We're ready to move the vendor onboarding forward but have a couple of items that need alignment before we register VertaCloud as an approved supplier in Ariba:

1) MSA redlines: attaching our redline (VertaCloud_MSA_redline_v3.pdf). Please confirm whether Redwood can accept our liability cap language and the data-scope carveouts.

2) PO field mapping: procurement needs the exact required fields for automatic PO ingestion into our ERP. I've attached a sample CSV (PO_field_mapping_sample.csv) showing the fields our AP system expects (PO number, line-level GL code, tax jurisdiction, remit address id). We need to confirm which of those Redwood will populate on outbound invoices/PO acknowledgements.

3) Portal provisioning: we use Ariba. To complete supplier setup we need a contact, supplier taxonomy, and the Ariba supplier ID. If Redwood has field constraints (max lengths, accepted enums) let us know so we can map accordingly.

Proposed timeline: legal redline confirmation by Wed 5/5, supplier provisioning in Ariba by Fri 5/7, and a handoff call the week of 5/10 to test a sample PO flow.

Can you loop in your legal and technical leads?

Thanks,

Helen Park
Head of Procurement | VertaCloud
T: +1 415-555-0198
hpark@vertacloud.com

Attachments: VertaCloud_MSA_redline_v3.pdf, PO_field_mapping_sample.csv

Hi Helen — thanks for the note and the attachments. Looping in Legal (Marissa) and Solutions (Dev) to triage the two parallel tracks (contract redline + portal field mapping). Quick plan from our side: 

- Legal (Marissa) will review the MSA redline and get back with line-level comments and any non-starter items by EOD Tue 5/4.
- Solutions (Dev) will validate the CSV and flag any field/format differences that would block Ariba auto-ingest; he can also provide our preferred field names and max lengths for mapping by Tue 5/4.
- I'll coordinate the Ariba admin handoff and propose a 30-min intake call for Wed 5/5 10:00am PT to walk through the PO sample and registration steps.

Can you confirm availability for the Wed 10:00am slot? If that works I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Best,

Soojin Lee

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Helen Park <hpark@vertacloud.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: MSA redline + PO field mapping (VertaCloud)

Hi Helen / Soojin,

Thanks — I reviewed VertaCloud_MSA_redline_v3.pdf and added line-level comments (attached: MSA_Redline_Comments_Marissa.pdf). High-level position: we can accept most of the edits but have two items that require negotiation or a procurement exception: 

1) Liability cap & carveouts: your redline removes our negotiated aggregate cap and expands carveouts for indirect data processing. We're willing to accept a narrower carveout limited to regulatory disclosure (subpoena/mandatory disclosure), but cannot accept an uncapped indemnity for derivative claims. Proposed compromise: keep Redwood's aggregate cap equal to 12 months' fees and add explicit carveouts for third-party claims arising from regulated data disclosures only.

2) PO acceptance & invoicing: the MSA currently references "electronic acceptance via portal" as sufficient. Procurement's PO schema indicates you rely on line-level GL codes and a remit address ID for correct routing. We request that the order form include a short clause: Redwood will populate PO-number, line-item quantities, and tax jurisdiction on invoice PDFs or the EDI/Ariba acknowledgement. If VertaCloud cannot surface GL code at line level, we need the vendor portal to accept a custom field (GL_CODE) during supplier setup.

If VertaCloud can confirm support for a GL_CODE field in Ariba, legal can tidy the Order Form language to reflect that capability. Otherwise we will need to scope a manual workaround and an internal billing exception.

Proposed next steps: 
- Helen: confirm whether Ariba supplier profile supports a custom field for GL codes and provide a sample of the Ariba supplier ID/portal admin URL.
- Dev: confirm whether Redwood can add GL_CODE to outbound invoice metadata or the Ariba acknowledgement payload (yes/no + estimated implementation effort).
- I can prepare a redline of the Order Form clause once we confirm the technical feasibility.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: MSA_Redline_Comments_Marissa.pdf

From: Helen Park <hpark@vertacloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: MSA redline + PO field mapping (VertaCloud)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear options. Quick answers: 

- Ariba supplier profile: we can add a custom attribute for GL_CODE (we call it "CustomField-GLCode"). I'll share an admin view link in the calendar invite.
- Ariba supplier ID: S-987654321 (please include in the supplier record).
- We can accept the proposed timeline. Please send the Order Form redline once Dev confirms the ACK payload.

I've scheduled the intake call: Wed May 5, 10:00am PT (calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234). Agenda: 1) Field mapping review (15m) 2) MSA redline highlights (10m) 3) Next steps & timeline (5m).

Helen Park
